title: Cortex Agent Registry Entry
description: Mode-agnostic agent registry entry. Per general-mode-design.md §6.4: registry.yaml + capabilities/ + external/ + credentials/. This schema describes a single agent entry; project-wide registry aggregates a list of these.

agent_id.description: Stable agent id, e.g. Worker-A-MS001, codex-main, claude-code-user.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the agent self-declares (e.g. schema_design, javascript, testing, vision, code_review).

items.description: Project id (normalized kebab-case) this agent subscribes to.

projects.description: P-002 project scope: authorization-free subscription/identity scope. Absent or [] means no project scope. Changing these values is additive and does not change schema_version.

recall.description: P-002 recall opt-in flag: whether the agent participates in team knowledge recall precheck.

external.description: External agent adapter metadata (v1.11). null for first-party agents.
